settings.title: Dynamic Performance
settings.body: Tune your ride instantly. From technical single-track to wide-open desert runs, adjust power delivery on the fly. The proprietary Neon-Drive controller technology guarantees immediate response, unleashing a massive 250Nm of instant torque at any speed, pushing the boundaries of what an electric dirt bike can achieve.

settings.heading: Enduro
settings.body: Optimized for maximum efficiency and range. Smooth torque delivery preserves battery life for long, technical backcountry explorations without sacrificing necessary low-end grunt.

settings.heading: Trail
settings.body: The perfect balance of power and agility. Dialed for responsive acceleration and precise handling on tight, winding tracks and varied off-road conditions.

settings.heading: Racer
settings.body: Unleash the full 80 HP and 250Nm of torque. Minimal intervention, maximum aggressive mapping for competitive track days and wide-open throttle blasts.

settings.title: Master Any Terrain
settings.body: Switch seamlessly between three distinct ride profiles engineered for varying demands, putting total control over the powertrain directly at your fingertips.

settings.label: Motor
settings.body: Direct drive permanent magnet motor delivering instantaneous torque. The advanced liquid cooling system guarantees sustained peak performance, completely eliminating thermal throttling even during the most demanding climbs or prolonged high-speed runs.

settings.label: Battery
settings.body: High-density performance pack housed in a structural carbon fiber casing utilizing premium Samsung 21700 cells. Capable of a rapid 45-minute fast charge to 80%, ensuring you spend more time riding and less time waiting.

settings.label: Suspension
settings.body: Fully adjustable inverted front forks and rear monoshock, meticulously tuned for extreme off-road compression. Features a sophisticated 24-way adjustable high-speed compression damping system to perfectly dial in the ride feel for any rider weight or terrain type.

settings.label: Brakes
settings.body: 4-piston radial-mount calipers on oversized floating rotors provide fade-free, maximum stopping power. This is seamlessly integrated with an aggressive regenerative braking system that recaptures kinetic energy, extending your range while saving pad wear.

settings.title: Carbon Monocoque
settings.body: Aerospace-grade layup for ultimate strength-to-weight ratio.

settings.title: IP67 Rated
settings.body: Fully sealed electronics and powertrain for extreme conditions.

settings.title: Zero Compromise
settings.body_1: Built to withstand the most brutal environments on earth. The foundation of the NEON-DIRT is an ultra-lightweight, aerospace-grade carbon fiber monocoque frame that offers unprecedented torsional rigidity while shedding crucial pounds.
settings.body_2: We don't let a little water stop the ride. The entire powertrain, battery enclosure, and all critical electronics boast a rigorous IP67 waterproof rating, allowing for deep water crossings and muddy bogs without a second thought.

settings.title: Total Control
settings.body: The NEON LINK app transforms your smartphone into a digital dashboard. Monitor battery health down to the cell, track your ride telemetry, and receive over-the-air performance upgrades seamlessly.
